{{Quote|This is all the Revanites fault. A thousand years of history treated like a battleground.|Sabri|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Sabri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], she was part of [[Darth Marr]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] coalition along with Republic forces under [[Satele Shan]]. The only person in her unit assigned to operate on the service, Sabri asked a fellow Coalition member to retrieve the ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] around the [[Temple of Sacrifice]] for preservation.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Dark Lord! This will be studied and go to your vaults, I swear. The Reclamation Service will not fail you.|Sabri to [[Darth Nox]]|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
Lieutenant Sabri appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

Sabri's dialogue changes based on whether the player is aligned with the Galactic Republic or Sith Empire, as well as if they are a Sith Inquisitor.<ref name="SWTOR" />
